implementation.name: Blue Print (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 42 HDL source files (5 systemverilog, 22 verilog, 15 vhdl) alongside 5 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 4 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 3 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 1 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 3 distinct machine_id rows. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file and no license grant was found in the HDL headers read (Arcade-BluePrint.sv, build_id.v). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 42 source files (5 systemverilog, 22 verilog, 15 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
